intro.narration: [excited] Heey — ninety-seven times ninety-two, in your head? [pause] Watch this.

steps.narration: [curious] Look at them. [pause] Both sit just under a hundred. That's all you need.
[confident] How far is each one from a hundred? [pause] Three … and eight.
[confident] Now subtract crosswise. Ninety-seven minus eight is eighty-nine. [pause] That's the front.
[excited] Multiply the two gaps. Three times eight is twenty-four. [pause] Stick it on the back — eight-nine-two-four.
[thoughtful] One catch. Gaps of twelve and eleven give one thirty-two — over ninety-nine, so it carries: seven-eight-three-two. [warm] Try your own.
